skill_name: Compare and contrast the impacts of air pollution on both urban and rural places.
workflow: There are several differences in the impacts of air pollution on urban and rural places. In rural areas, air pollution can have a negative effect on human health due to the concentration of fine particles in the air. The health impacts are greater due to inadequate infrastructure such as water systems, transport, energy and healthcare, which are all more limited in rural areas.
